newsitem.title: BELARUS: IMF mission to visit Belarus June 4-17.
newsitem.headline: IMF mission to visit Belarus June 4-17.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund mission will visit Belarus in June but there will be no discussions on resumption of credits to the former Soviet republic, an IMF representative said on Tuesday.
The mission will evaluate Belarus's economic development from June 4-17, the representative said.
The IMF froze a $250 million stand-by credit in January, 1996 after Belarus failed to meet conditions for economic restructuring, including privatisation goals.
Belarus is seeking closer ties to reform-minded Moscow and has indicated some interest in economic restructuring.
